parties.petitioner: The General Manager, M/S Barsua Iron Ore Mines
parties.respondent: The Vice President United Mines Mazdoor Union and Ors.

summary: Dispute over respondent's date of birth affecting retirement benefits; respondent initially declared DOB as 27.12.1948, later changed to 12.03.1955 based on School Transfer Certificate; CGIT awarded 50% back wages from 2008–2015 based on revised DOB; High Court upheld award; Appellant challenged award, claiming double benefit and res judicata; Respondent claimed recording error and production of genuine documentary proof; Issue: whether respondent can resile from initial declaration to claim extended service.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; judgment of High Court and CGIT set aside; respondent not entitled to back wages based on revised date of birth; continued employment beyond 60 not justified; initial declaration binding; respondent gained undue benefit by delayed correction.
